name: Grombrindal, the White Dwarf
canonNotes: The legendary White Dwarf, widely held to be Snorri Whitebeard, first High King, returned to aid his people in their darkest hours.
Appears where he is needed and vanishes again; an ancestral figure more than a ruler of one hold.
voiceNotes: Ancient, calm and knowing; speaks like a grandfather of his whole race.
Dry humour, deep loyalty to all Dwarfs, contempt for elves and oath-breakers.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
